title: ChatContact/get: per-ID store lookup is O(n) round trips under Mutex — N separate SQL queries for N ids
description: ChatContactGetHandler (contact.rs:85-99) and MessageGetHandler (message.rs:752-756) iterate a list of IDs and call get_by_peer_user_id / messages().get() once per ID, all under the same Mutex guard. This is N separate SQL queries for N IDs. For ChatContact this is capped by the contact count (typically small). For Message/get the caller must supply ids explicitly (ids=null rejected), so N is bounded by the caller. Not a hot path issue at Phase 1 scale, but if a client sends ids: [1000 message IDs] this is 1000 sequential SQL lookups. Worth noting as a future improvement: a single IN-clause query (like load_attachments_for_messages already does) would be far more efficient.
